chapter: Second session: boyhood, brothers and early road years
title: Getting bookings by word of mouth
summary: Small Arizona towns spread news of the piano-and-drums duo quickly, and drunk German patrons paid in advance.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: How'd you go about getting the jobs? How did you get bookings? Did your brother know people in that area, or how...?

Well, he had played around there, and people knew he was a piano player but they didn't know he had drums, but after ...after one or two dances, why then everybody in town knew it, you know. Them little towns--everybody in town knew it.
So it was kind of a word-of-mouth thing. They heard about you and got in touch with you kept getting jobs.

Yeah. We used to play for a bunch of Germans, and when we come in...when we walk in...when we'd go in, they'd pay us 'cause they knew they were gonna get drunk, so they'd pay us before we even started. And, in about a couple of hours, they'd all be drunk. And we would be the music, you know, and it was a lot of fun...
